thread: Rae: heads-up i'm starting a staged refactor to move /docs/reference -> /docs/api-reference. planning many small PRs to minimize link churn. outline below and asking for reviewers. Oliver: +1 on small PRs. what's the exact sequence you want? Rae: sequence: (1) PR move-only files + redirects.yaml + mappings.csv, (2) wait for preview/staging propagation, (3) PR update anchors & cross-links, (4) PR add SDK snippets and examples. each PR tagged `docs/refactor/phase-2`. Nina: can we include legacy-anchors.json for fragment mappings in PR1? runtime doesn't rewrite fragments so we need to preserve anchor ids on targets. Rae: yes. PR1 will include legacy-anchors.json listing known fragment mappings and we will also add explicit `` stubs in target pages where feasible. Kai: i'll add an anchor-stability job to CI that runs after build and reports missing legacy anchors. non-blocking for PR1 but blocking for PR2. Docs Bot: preview created: https://deploy.previews.redwood.test/1768839999 build OK, link-check shows 2 anchor mismatches: auth#token-flow, deploy#vpc-setup. Rae: noted. i'll add explicit anchors for those two in the next commit. Oliver: reviewers: i can take PR1 early morning, nina can review PR2. prefer merges before 2pm PT. Nina: i'll prioritize PR2 review but will wait until PR1 redirects are live in staging so internal links don't break. CI Bot: merge queue note PR1 requires 2 approvals. will re-run anchor-stability on push. Rae: opening PR1 now: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/8499. will post updates here when preview passes and redirect manifest is published. Oliver: thanks, will review shortly. Rae: thanks all. plan to monitor Search Console and Sentry for 1 hour after merge.
